mapper.select: SELECT T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T1.VPAY_DATE vpayDate FROM FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT T1 INNER JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID AND T1.BRANCH = T2.BRANCH AND T2.TYPE_6 = #{TARGET_BACK_TYPE_H01} AND T2.TYPE_7 IN (#{BACK_LEND_DIRECTION_03},#{BACK_LEND_DIRECTION_04}) LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_TEMP_DEAL T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID AND T1.BRANCH = T3.BRANCH AND T3.PS IN (#{PS_03},#{PS_04}) LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T4 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T4.FINPROD_ID AND T1.BRANCH = T4.BRANCH AND T4.PS IN (#{PS_03},#{PS_04}) AND T4.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} AND T4.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_TEMP_DEAL T5 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T5.FINPROD_ID AND T1.BRANCH = T5.BRANCH AND T5.PS IN (#{PS_T07},#{PS_T56},#{PS_C20},#{PS_T56},#{PS_T93},#{PS_T95},#{PS_T96}) LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL T6 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T6.FINPROD_ID AND T1.BRANCH = T6.BRANCH AND T6.PS IN (#{PS_T07},#{PS_T56},#{PS_C20},#{PS_T56},#{PS_T93},#{PS_T95},#{PS_T96}) AND T6.TRADE_STATUS = #{TRADE_STATUS_01} AND T6.IS_CANCEL = #{YES_OR_NO_N} WHERE T1.BRANCH = '0' AND T1.TRADE_MARKET = #{TRADE_PLACE_04} AND T1.MPAY_DATE = TO_DATE(#{sysDate},'yyyy-mm-dd') AND (T5.TRADE_ID IS NULL and T6.TRADE_ID IS NULL)
